title: populus tremula f. pilosa
intro: Populus tremula f. pilosa, commonly known as Russian aspen or downy aspen, is a subspecies of the aspen tree that is native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral effects, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Populus tremula f. pilosa include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating bronchitis, coughs, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential therapeutic applications.
